source_title: ‘Distorians’ cannot erase the profound respect Indira Gandhi had for Vallabhbhai Patel: Jairam Ramesh
source_excerpt: New Delhi Congress leader Jairam Ramesh on Saturday (October 31, 2026) shared a rare photograph from 1947 featuring a young Indira Gandhi greeting Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who was then Deputy Prime Minister, and said “distorians” cannot erase the profound respect and admiration that Indira Gandhi had for the Congress stalwart. Sharing the picture in which Indira Gandhi is seen greeting Patel as Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru looks on, Mr. Ramesh said it was taken in early November 1947 in New Delhi, during a function hosted by the Prime Minister for delegates to the Asian Regional Conference of the International Labour Organisation. The picture shows a 30-year-old Indira Gandhi greeting the 72-year-old Deputy Prime Minister, he said. “Distorians cannot erase the profound respect and admiration that Indira Gandhi had for Sardar Patel, and she spoke from her heart on the occasion of his birth centenary. And Sardar Patel’s was the only statue of a living person that Nehru himself unveiled in Godhra on February 13, 1949,” Mr. Ramesh said.
